name: @oath-md/oath-mcp

tools.name: calculate_aa_gradient
tools.description:
Compute the alveolar-arterial oxygen gradient and the age-expected gradient to evaluate the mechanism of hypoxemia. A normal A-a gradient points to hypoventilation or low inspired oxygen; an elevated gradient points to V/Q mismatch, shunt, or diffusion limitation.
Do NOT use when: The gradient becomes unreliable at high FiO2 and in the elderly, and is distorted by mechanical ventilation with PEEP; it is not disease-specific and must be read in clinical context.

pao2.description: Arterial oxygen partial pressure (PaO2) in mmHg.

paco2.description: Arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure (PaCO2) in mmHg.

fio2.description: Fraction of inspired oxygen as a percentage (21 to 100).

age.description: Patient age in years (used for the age-expected gradient).

altitude.description: Altitude in meters; leave unset for sea level.

tools.name: calculate_abg
tools.description:
Return typed acid-base findings, provenance, availability, and limitations without inventing a diagnosis or treatment plan.
Do NOT use when: Do not use venous PCO2 for arterial ventilatory decisions or interpret any branch without the clinical context and laboratory reference interval.

pH.description: Compatibility alias for ph. Prefer ph.

paco2.description: Measured arterial or peripheral venous PCO2 in mmHg; sample_type controls whether arterial compensation rules are available.

PaCO2.description: Compatibility alias for paco2. Prefer paco2.

HCO3.description: Compatibility alias for bicarbonate. Prefer bicarbonate.

sodium.description: Serum sodium; bare values use mEq/L and mmol/L is accepted explicitly.

Na.description: Compatibility alias for sodium. Prefer sodium.

Cl.description: Compatibility alias for chloride. Prefer chloride.

albumin.description: Serum albumin; if omitted, the corrected gap explicitly records use of the 4.0 g/dL reference default.

sample_type.description: Arterial or peripheral venous sample. Defaults to arterial only when neither sample_type nor the deprecated venous_sample flag is supplied.

venous_sample.description: Backward-compatible flag; prefer sample_type. True means peripheral_venous and false means arterial.

is_venous.description: Compatibility alias for venous_sample. Prefer venous_sample.

tools.name: calculate_anion_gap
tools.description:
Compute uncorrected anion gap plus optional historical albumin correction and delta arithmetic from concurrent laboratories. Treat every result as an aid requiring local reference intervals and clinical context.
Do NOT use when: The delta ratio is only meaningful in metabolic acidosis with an elevated anion gap; it is omitted when those conditions are not met. Do not interpret it in isolation from the clinical picture.

sodium.description: Serum sodium in mEq/L (numerically equal to mmol/L). Normal 135-145.

chloride.description: Serum chloride in mEq/L (numerically equal to mmol/L). Normal 96-106.

bicarbonate.description: Serum bicarbonate in mEq/L (numerically equal to mmol/L). Normal 22-29.

albumin.description: Serum albumin. Pass a bare number in g/dL, or {value, unit} for SI (g/L). When omitted, only uncorrected outputs are returned; the calculator does not silently assume 4.0 g/dL.

tools.name: calculate_apgar
tools.description:
Rapidly assess a newborn's condition at 1 and 5 minutes after birth from five observations (Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, Respiratory). Each is scored 0-2; the total (0-10) records condition at an explicit assessment minute and supports serial documentation.
Do NOT use when: Not a predictor of long-term neurological outcome and not a substitute for cord-blood gas analysis. Never delay or decide initial resuscitation from the score; record concurrent interventions.

assessment_minute.description: Standard expanded-form time point. Record at 1 and 5 minutes; if the 5-minute score is below 7, record every 5 minutes through 20 minutes while assessments continue.

oxygen.description: Whether oxygen was being administered at this assessment time.

ppv_or_ncpap.description: Whether positive-pressure ventilation or nasal continuous positive airway pressure was being delivered.

endotracheal_tube.description: Whether an endotracheal tube was in place at this assessment time.

chest_compressions.description: Whether chest compressions were being delivered at this assessment time.

epinephrine.description: Whether epinephrine was being administered at this assessment time.

grimace.description: Reflex irritability in response to stimulation.

tools.name: calculate_bmi
tools.description:
Compute adult BMI from measured weight and height and return the CDC adult screening category. Interpret it with other health factors.
Do NOT use when: Do not calculate without establishing adult applicability and obtaining both measured height and measured weight.

weight.description: Compatibility alias for weight_kg. Prefer weight_kg.

tools.name: calculate_bsa
tools.description:
Compute raw BSA (m²) with the Mosteller formula when the governing protocol names this variant. Do not infer a dose or cap.
Do NOT use when: Do not calculate without a protocol naming the Mosteller variant and both measured height and measured weight.

weight.description: Compatibility alias for weight_kg. Prefer weight_kg.

tools.name: calculate_bsa_dubois
tools.description:
Compute raw BSA (m²) with the Du Bois and Du Bois formula when a governing protocol explicitly names this variant. Do not infer a dose or cap.
Do NOT use when: Do not calculate without a protocol naming the Du Bois variant and both measured height and measured weight.

tools.name: calculate_carboplatin_auc
tools.description:
Compute a protocol-specified adult carboplatin dose with the Calvert formula while making kidney-function method, indexed-to-absolute conversion, treatment intent, cap policy, and rounding provenance explicit.
Do NOT use when: Do not infer a kidney-function method, cap, target AUC, or treatment protocol. Prefer measured GFR when estimated kidney function may be unreliable.

target_auc.description: Target area under the curve in mg/mL × min (e.g. 5-6 for ovarian cancer).

gfr.description: Measured or estimated kidney-function value. Supply the units/status separately; indexed values are converted to absolute mL/min using patient BSA.

kidney_function_method.description: Exact method used to obtain the supplied kidney-function value.

kidney_function_indexing.description: Whether the supplied value is absolute mL/min or indexed to 1.73 m².

patient_bsa.description: Patient body surface area in m²; required only for an indexed kidney-function value.

treatment_intent.description: Treatment intent used to judge whether estimated kidney function is appropriate.

cap_policy.description: Explicit governing cap policy. ADDIKD 2022 does not recommend a universal cap; the NCI option applies only to affected protocols using estimated GFR.

rounding_policy.description: Explicit final-dose rounding policy. No intermediate values are rounded before the Calvert result.

tools.name: calculate_chadsvasc
tools.description:
Estimate annual stroke and thromboembolism risk in a patient with non-valvular atrial fibrillation from eight weighted risk factors (congestive heart failure, hypertension, age, diabetes, prior stroke/TIA/thromboembolism, vascular disease, and sex). Use the score with current annual-risk guidance and patient-specific modifiers, not alone.
Do NOT use when: Do not apply these treatment thresholds in patients with a mechanical heart valve or moderate-to-severe rheumatic mitral stenosis. This score does not estimate bleeding risk; assess that separately.

age_group.description: Patient's age group. Age 65-74 scores +1, age >= 75 scores +2.

sex.description: Biological sex. Female sex scores +1 as a risk modifier.

gender.description: Compatibility alias for sex. Prefer sex.

stroke_history.description: Prior stroke, TIA, or thromboembolism. Scores +2.

vascular_disease.description: Vascular disease (MI, PAD, or aortic plaque). Scores +1.

tools.name: calculate_chemo_dose_bsa
tools.description:
Compute an individual chemotherapy drug dose from a protocol-specified mg/m² dose and the patient's body surface area: calculated_dose = dose_per_m2 × BSA, then final_dose after any percentage reduction. BSA is not capped unless the caller explicitly enables the protocol-specific 2.0 m² cap.
Do NOT use when: Verify the regimen, body-size dosing policy, dose-reduction rationale, and final rounded dose with oncology pharmacy. Do not enable the BSA cap unless the applicable protocol explicitly requires it.

bsa.description: Patient body surface area in m².

dose_reduction.description: Percentage dose reduction (0 for full dose, e.g. 25 for a 25% reduction).

cap_bsa.description: Set true only when the applicable regimen explicitly caps BSA at 2.0 m².

tools.name: calculate_child_pugh
tools.description:
Adults with established cirrhosis whose bilirubin, albumin, INR, ascites, and encephalopathy categories are available. Return an integer score from 5-15 and descriptive class A (5-6), B (7-9), or C (10-15).
Do NOT use when: A broad cirrhosis severity class, not individualized survival, operative-risk, transplant-allocation, or treatment advice. Ascites and encephalopathy grading are subjective; apply only to the explicit modified INR variant in established cirrhosis.

bilirubin_category.description: Total serum bilirubin: <2 mg/dL (1), 2-3 mg/dL (2), or >3 mg/dL (3).

bilirubin.description: Compatibility alias for bilirubin_category. Prefer bilirubin_category.

albumin_category.description: Serum albumin: >3.5 g/dL (1), 2.8-3.5 g/dL (2), or <2.8 g/dL (3).

albumin.description: Compatibility alias for albumin_category. Prefer albumin_category.

inr.description: Compatibility alias for inr_category. Prefer inr_category.

ascites.description: Ascites: none (1), mild/medication-controlled (2), or moderate-to-severe refractory (3).

encephalopathy.description: Hepatic encephalopathy: none (1), Grade 1-2 (2), or Grade 3-4 (3).

tools.name: calculate_corrected_calcium
tools.description:
Reproduce the legacy conventional 0.8-factor arithmetic only when a user explicitly asks for that historical value; state that it is not a proxy for ionized calcium and is not supported for calcium-status classification.
Do NOT use when: Do not use the adjusted value to diagnose, classify, or manage calcium status. Prefer measured ionized calcium when accuracy matters.

calcium.description: Measured total calcium. Pass a bare number in mg/dL, or {value, unit} for SI (mmol/L).

albumin.description: Serum albumin. Pass a bare number in g/dL, or {value, unit} for SI (g/L).

tools.name: calculate_creatinine_clearance
tools.description:
Calculate the 1976 Cockcroft-Gault estimate only after the caller explicitly supplies the body weight selected under the relevant drug label or dosing protocol.
Do NOT use when: Do not silently choose actual, ideal, adjusted, or lean body weight. Do not use with non-steady-state creatinine, as measured clearance, or for KDIGO GFR-category staging.

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kilograms explicitly selected under the relevant drug label or protocol. The calculator does not choose a weight scalar.

weight.description: Compatibility alias for weight_kg. Prefer weight_kg.

creatinine.description: Serum creatinine. Pass a bare number in mg/dL, or {value, unit} for SI (umol/L). Normal 0.7-1.3 mg/dL.

sex.description: Biological sex; female applies the 0.85 Cockcroft-Gault factor.

gender.description: Compatibility alias for sex. Prefer sex.

tools.name: calculate_csf
tools.description:
Separate derived values, confirmed assay reports, compatible patterns, differentials, missing context, and limitations.
Do NOT use when: Do not convert a nonspecific CSF pattern or unidentified positive assay into a disease diagnosis.

age_years.description: Age in completed years; adult reference flags are suppressed below 18.

wbc_per_ul.description: Observed white-cell count per microlitre before any selected traumatic-tap correction.

traumatic_tap_method.description: Explicit selected heuristic; none preserves the observed WBC.

appearance.description: Reported CSF appearance; visual xanthochromia is not equivalent to spectrophotometric bilirubin.

serum_glucose_mmol_l.description: Blood glucose measured immediately before lumbar puncture for the CSF-to-blood ratio.

protein_mg_dl.description: Total CSF protein in mg/dL; reference limits are age and laboratory dependent.

fungal_assay.description: Identity of the fungal assay; nonspecific beta-D-glucan is kept distinct from organism-specific testing.

oligoclonal_band_status.description: Paired CSF/serum OCB relationship, not a standalone multiple-sclerosis diagnosis.

neural_antibody_specimen.description: Specimen context for the neural-antibody result.

symptom_onset_days.description: Approximate days from symptom onset to lumbar puncture.

immune_status.description: Broad immune-status context that changes pattern and assay interpretation.

imaging_context.description: Imaging context relevant to haemorrhage and alternative diagnoses.

xanthochromia_result.description: Explicit reported result of the selected xanthochromia assessment; visual appearance is not substituted for a spectrophotometric bilirubin result.

hours_from_onset_to_lumbar_puncture.description: Timing used only for the NICE spectrophotometric xanthochromia context.

tools.name: calculate_eos
tools.description:
Calculate the selected Kaiser EOS model's risk at birth and clinical-appearance-adjusted risk, with model-specific recommendations and an explicit model-version choice.
Do NOT use when: Do not use below 35 weeks gestation or silently choose the 2024 model where universal antenatal GBS screening is not practiced. Clinical illness takes precedence over a reassuring numeric estimate.

model_version.description: Select the 2024 updated model only where universal antenatal GBS screening is practiced; otherwise select the original 2017 model.

baseline_incidence.description: Baseline incidence of EOS per 1000 live births for the population.

rom_hours.description: Duration of rupture of membranes in hours.

gestational_age.description: Gestational age in weeks (35-43, may include decimals for days).

tools.name: calculate_fib4
tools.description:
Calculate the published FIB-4 index and apply the selected 2026 AGA adult MASLD first-tier threshold. A low result is FIB-4 below 1.3 for ages 35-64 or below 2.0 for ages 65 and older; otherwise return that secondary fibrosis assessment is needed. Below age 35, return the score without a pathway interpretation.
Do NOT use when: Do not use during acute illness, with non-contemporaneous or unstable laboratory values, below age 18, or as a stand-alone diagnosis or fibrosis stage. This implementation intentionally does not apply the separate 2.67 referral threshold retained by AASLD 2023 and EASL 2024.

age.description: Age in completed years at the time of the laboratory tests.

ast.description: Aspartate aminotransferase. Pass a bare number in U/L, or an object {value, unit} to supply U/L or ukat/L.

alt.description: Alanine aminotransferase. Pass a bare number in U/L, or an object {value, unit} to supply U/L or ukat/L.

platelet_count.description: Platelet count. Pass a bare number in 10^9/L, or an object {value, unit} to supply 10^9/L or 10^3/uL; these units are numerically equivalent.

assessment_context.description: Whether the contemporaneous laboratory values come from a stable ambulatory assessment or an acute illness.

tools.name: calculate_free_water_deficit
tools.description:
Estimate an adult static electrolyte-free water deficit from weight, current sodium, target sodium, and an explicit adult TBW category.
Do NOT use when: Do not use as a fluid prescription or correction-rate target, in children, or without accounting separately for ongoing losses and gains.

current_sodium.description: Current serum sodium in mEq/L (must exceed the ideal sodium for hypernatremia).

ideal_sodium.description: Target serum sodium in mEq/L (defaults to 140).

patient_category.description: Patient category selecting the % total body water.

demographic.description: Compatibility alias for patient_category. Prefer patient_category.

tools.name: calculate_gad7
tools.description:
Adults completing the original seven self-reported symptom-frequency items for the preceding two weeks. Return an integer symptom score from 0-21 with minimal, mild, moderate, and severe ranges; score 10 is a screening cut point, not a diagnosis.
Do NOT use when: A screening and symptom-severity instrument, not a diagnosis. A positive screen requires diagnostic assessment. It does not assess suicidality or replace urgent crisis and safety evaluation.

feeling_nervous.description: How often have you been bothered by feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge over the last 2 weeks?

cannot_control_worrying.description: How often have you been bothered by not being able to stop or control worrying over the last 2 weeks?

worrying_too_much.description: How often have you been bothered by worrying too much about different things over the last 2 weeks?

trouble_relaxing.description: How often have you been bothered by trouble relaxing over the last 2 weeks?

restlessness.description: How often have you been bothered by being so restless that it's hard to sit still over the last 2 weeks?

easily_annoyed.description: How often have you been bothered by becoming easily annoyed or irritable over the last 2 weeks?

feeling_afraid.description: How often have you been bothered by feeling afraid as if something awful might happen over the last 2 weeks?

tools.name: calculate_gcs
tools.description:
Record Glasgow Coma Scale components and a total only when all three components are testable; preserve Not Testable reasons and modifiers.
Do NOT use when: Do not manufacture a total when any component is Not Testable, and do not generalize traumatic-brain-injury severity labels to other contexts.

assessment_context.description: Context in which the component responses were assessed.

modifier_context.description: Dominant factor affecting interpretation; choose a component's Not Testable option whenever that response cannot actually be tested.

eye_opening.description: Best observed eye-opening response, or Not Testable when local factors prevent assessment.

verbal_response.description: Best observed verbal response, or Not Testable with an explicit reason.

motor_response.description: Best observed motor response, or Not Testable when a physical limitation prevents assessment.

tools.name: calculate_gfr
tools.description:
Calculate adult 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine eGFR and its KDIGO GFR category. Do not diagnose CKD from a single category or silently substitute indexed eGFR for a drug label's required kidney-function method.
Do NOT use when: Do not use in patients under 18, during acute kidney injury, as an exact GFR measurement, or when creatinine is changing rapidly or strongly affected by non-GFR factors. Confirm values near critical decisions with cystatin C or measured GFR.

creatinine.description: Standardized serum creatinine. Pass a bare number in mg/dL, or an object {value, unit} to supply SI units (umol/L).

sex.description: Biological sex used by the CKD-EPI equation (male or female).

tools.name: calculate_gir
tools.description:
Compute the glucose infusion rate (mg/kg/min) delivered by a dextrose infusion, from patient weight, dextrose concentration, and infusion rate. Used chiefly in neonatal and parenteral-nutrition management.
Do NOT use when: Reflects only the carbohydrate delivered by the specified infusion; it does not account for enteral intake or other dextrose-containing fluids running concurrently.

weight.description: Compatibility alias for weight_kg. Prefer weight_kg.

dextrose_concentration.description: Dextrose concentration as a percentage (g/100 mL), e.g. 10 for D10.

tools.name: calculate_grace
tools.description:
Estimate cumulative mortality from hospital admission through 6 months after acute coronary syndrome using the eight-variable Fox 2006 GRACE nomogram. Return both the nomogram score and its published mortality lookup percentage.
Do NOT use when: Do not use as a general cardiovascular-risk score or confuse this cumulative admission-to-6-month model with the separate post-discharge model. Apply only to adults presenting with acute coronary syndrome and use clinical judgment when inputs fall outside the derivation population.

heart_rate.description: Heart rate in beats per minute at presentation.

systolic_bp.description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg at presentation.

creatinine.description: Serum creatinine at presentation. Pass a bare number in mg/dL or {value, unit} for SI.

killip_class.description: Killip class at presentation: I (no heart failure), II (S3 or rales), III (pulmonary edema), or IV (cardiogenic shock).

cardiac_arrest.description: Whether cardiac arrest occurred at admission.

st_segment_deviation.description: Whether the presenting ECG shows ST-segment deviation.

elevated_cardiac_enzymes.description: Whether initial cardiac enzymes or markers are elevated.

tools.name: calculate_hepb
tools.description:
Map an explicit HBsAg, total anti-HBc, and anti-HBs state to a typed CDC pattern while preserving uncertainty and contradictions.
Do NOT use when: Do not infer a complete pattern from omitted, unknown, or not-tested markers, and do not use HBe markers alone to label disease phase or infectivity.

hbsag.description: Explicit surface-antigen state; do not substitute not_tested or unknown with negative.

anti_hbs.description: Explicit surface-antibody state; a positive result implies vaccine immunity only when total anti-HBc is negative and vaccination is documented.

igm_anti_hbc.description: Supplemental recent-infection marker; IgM can also be positive during chronic flares or reactivation.

hbeag.description: Supplemental replication marker reported without assigning an infectivity level.

anti_hbe.description: Supplemental e-antibody marker reported without assigning an infectivity level.

tools.name: calculate_ibw
tools.description:
Compute the adult Devine ideal-body-weight descriptor from height and formula sex only when a governing protocol requests it.
Do NOT use when: Do not calculate below 60 inches (152.4 cm), without a formula sex input, or when the governing protocol specifies another size descriptor.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the Devine formula (male or female).

tools.name: calculate_ich_volume
tools.description:
Estimate spontaneous intraparenchymal hemorrhage volume (mL) from CT using the simplified slice-count ABC/2 approximation. Do not infer a prognosis or treatment threshold from this estimate alone.
Do NOT use when: Do not calculate without all four CT measurements and the declared compatibility shape input.

width_cm.description: Diameter perpendicular to A (B) in centimeters.

num_slices.description: Number of CT slices on which hemorrhage is seen.

ellipsoid_shape.description: Compatibility input retained from schema 1.0. Both values use ABC/2; false no longer selects the unsupported ABC/3 shortcut.

is_ellipsoid.description: Compatibility alias for ellipsoid_shape. Prefer ellipsoid_shape.

tools.name: calculate_kdpi
tools.description:
Calculate race- and HCV-free KDRI and map it to the current OPTN deceased-donor KDPI reference population, preserving donor-scoped inputs and the exact annual data snapshot.
Do NOT use when: One input among many in donor evaluation, not a standalone accept/decline rule. Uses the 2025 OPTN reference population and the mapping published from the 2026-04-03 database snapshot. OPTN updates this reference annually.

donor_hypertension.description: Known donor history of hypertension. If status is unknown, use the official OPTN calculator; do not coerce unknown to false.

donor_diabetes.description: Known donor history of diabetes. If status is unknown, use the official OPTN calculator; do not coerce unknown to false.

cause_of_death_cva.description: Cause of death is cerebrovascular accident/stroke.

cod_cva.description: Compatibility alias for cause_of_death_cva. Prefer cause_of_death_cva.

donor_creatinine.description: Donor serum creatinine. Pass a bare number in mg/dL, or {value, unit} for SI (umol/L). Values above 8 mg/dL are capped at 8 for the KDRI.

dcd.description: Compatibility alias for donation_after_circulatory_death. Prefer donation_after_circulatory_death.

tools.name: calculate_map
tools.description:
Approximate MAP from systolic and diastolic blood pressure using DBP plus one third of pulse pressure at a normal heart rate.
Do NOT use when: Do not calculate from a missing pressure or when systolic pressure is not greater than diastolic pressure.

systolic.description: Compatibility alias for systolic_bp. Prefer systolic_bp.

diastolic.description: Compatibility alias for diastolic_bp. Prefer diastolic_bp.

tools.name: calculate_meld
tools.description:
Calculate the current OPTN MELD 3.0 score used to assign medical-urgency priority to liver-transplant candidates age 12 years and older. The formula uses creatinine, bilirubin, INR, sodium, albumin, age at registration, and adult candidate sex; the reported score ranges from 6 to 40.
Do NOT use when: Do not use for candidates younger than 12 years, acute liver failure status decisions, exception-score determinations, or as a substitute for the OPTN match system. The adult female coefficient applies only when age at registration is at least 18 years.

creatinine.description: Serum creatinine. Pass a bare number in mg/dL or {value, unit} for SI. The formula uses 1-3 mg/dL and sets the value to 3 mg/dL when the dialysis criterion is met.

bilirubin.description: Total bilirubin. Pass a bare number in mg/dL or {value, unit} for SI. The formula floors values below 1 mg/dL.

inr.description: International normalized ratio. The formula floors values below 1.

sodium.description: Serum sodium. Pass a bare number in mEq/L or {value, unit}; the formula uses the range 125-137 mEq/L.

albumin.description: Serum albumin. Pass a bare number in g/dL or {value, unit} for SI; the formula uses the range 1.5-3.5 g/dL.

age_at_registration.description: Age in years when the candidate was registered. MELD applies from age 12; the adult sex coefficient applies from age 18.

age.description: Compatibility alias for age_at_registration. Prefer age_at_registration.

sex.description: Candidate sex used by the OPTN adult MELD calculation. Required when age at registration is 18 years or older.

dialysis.description: True after at least two dialysis sessions or at least 24 hours of continuous veno-venous hemodialysis in the preceding week.

tools.name: calculate_mews
tools.description:
Adults admitted acutely to medical wards and observed with the Subbe five-parameter physiological score. Return an integer score from 0-14; the original cohort associated a score of 5 or more with increased risk of death, ICU admission, or high-dependency admission.
Do NOT use when: An adult track-and-trigger aid, not a diagnosis or substitute for clinical judgment. The caller must classify observations into the exact Subbe bands. Do not transfer this adult medical-admission variant to children, pregnancy, critical care, or a different local escalation policy.

systolic_bp.description: Compatibility alias for systolic_bp_category. Prefer systolic_bp_category.

heart_rate.description: Compatibility alias for heart_rate_category. Prefer heart_rate_category.

respiratory_rate.description: Compatibility alias for respiratory_rate_category. Prefer respiratory_rate_category.

temperature.description: Compatibility alias for temperature_category. Prefer temperature_category.

avpu.description: Level of consciousness on the AVPU scale.

tools.name: calculate_morse_fall_scale
tools.description:
Calculate the original six-item Morse Fall Scale for an adult inpatient and report the total with the AHRQ toolkit's descriptive risk band.
Do NOT use when: A screening aid, not a diagnosis. Risk cut-off scores should be calibrated for each healthcare setting or unit so fall-prevention strategies target those most at risk; operational thresholds vary by institution.

history_of_falling.description: History of falling; immediate or within 3 months.

secondary_diagnosis.description: More than one medical diagnosis listed on the chart.

ambulatory_aid.description: Aid used for ambulation; furniture clutching scores highest.

iv_heparin_lock.description: Intravenous apparatus or heparin lock in place.

mental_status.description: Self-assessment of ability versus actual ability.

tools.name: calculate_neonatal_measurements
tools.description:
Return only the output families supported by the supplied weight, gestational age, postnatal timing, or corrected age, using typed numeric estimates and ranges.
Do NOT use when: Do not treat insertion estimates as confirmed position or reference BP distributions as intervention thresholds.

weight_grams.description: Birth weight in grams; drives Shukla UAC/UVC estimates.

gestational_age_weeks.description: Completed gestational weeks 22-43; drives Kempley ETT depth and, with explicit day-one timing, BP reference outputs where tabled.

gestational_age.description: Compatibility alias for gestational_age_weeks. Prefer gestational_age_weeks.

postnatal_age_hours.description: Hours since birth; day-one BP references are emitted only when this is explicitly 0 through 24 hours.

corrected_gestational_age_weeks.description: Corrected gestational age in completed weeks 24-46; drives corrected-age BP reference outputs.

corrected_gestational_age.description: Compatibility alias for corrected_gestational_age_weeks. Prefer corrected_gestational_age_weeks.

tools.name: calculate_nihss
tools.description:
Quantify stroke severity from 15 focused neurological items (consciousness, gaze, visual fields, facial and limb motor function, ataxia, sensation, language, dysarthria, and extinction/inattention). Each item is scored on its own scale (0-2, 0-3, or 0-4); the total (0-42) grades impairment — the higher the score, the more severe the stroke.
Do NOT use when: Full of caveats for patients with prior neurologic deficits (prior weakness, hemi-/quadriplegia, blindness), intubation, or a language barrier. In those cases consult the NIH Stroke Scale reference. Not a substitute for clinical judgment or imaging.

assessment_timing.description: Clinical timing of this NIHSS assessment; preserve it when comparing serial scores.

modifier_context.description: Dominant modifier affecting interpretation; use the specific UN option for an item that cannot be tested.

level_of_consciousness.description: May be assessed casually while taking history.

month_and_age.description: Ask about the current month and their age.

left_arm_motor.description: Count out loud and use your fingers to show the patient your count.

right_arm_motor.description: Same assessment as Left Arm Motor Drift.

right_leg_motor.description: Same assessment as Left Leg Motor Drift.

language.description: Describe the scene; name the items; read the sentences.

tools.name: calculate_oxygenation_index
tools.description:
Compute the neonatal Oxygenation Index (OI, from PaO2) and/or Oxygen Saturation Index (OSI, from SpO2) for hypoxemic respiratory failure or persistent pulmonary hypertension. Provide at least one of PaO2 or SpO2.
Do NOT use when: This calculator is scoped to neonates; do not apply these categories to pediatric ARDS or adults. A single OI value is not by itself a treatment trigger.

fio2.description: Fraction of inspired oxygen as a percentage (21 to 100).

pao2.description: Arterial oxygen partial pressure (PaO2) in mmHg. Provide this or SpO2.

spo2.description: Pulse-oximetry oxygen saturation (SpO2) as a percentage. Provide this or PaO2.

tools.name: calculate_pews
tools.description:
Pediatric inpatient deterioration warning score using behavior, cardiovascular, and respiratory domains against local age-specific norms. Return the integer Brighton PEWS result from 0-13 without inventing a universal response threshold; high and rising scores require interpretation under the local validated escalation policy.
Do NOT use when: A legacy pediatric inpatient deterioration score, not a diagnosis, emergency-department triage rule, or substitute for clinical concern. Local age-specific norms and escalation policy are required. The 2023 NHS England National PEWS is a different age-banded system and must not be represented by this calculator.

behavior.description: Assessment of the child's behavior and level of consciousness.

cardiovascular.description: Assessment of cardiovascular status, including color, capillary refill, and heart rate.

respiratory.description: Assessment of respiratory status, including respiratory rate, work of breathing, and oxygen requirements.

nebulizers.description: Whether the patient requires nebulizer treatments every 15 minutes. Adds 2 points when true.

vomiting.description: Whether the patient has persistent vomiting following surgery. Adds 2 points when true.

tools.name: calculate_qsofa
tools.description:
Adults with suspected infection in prehospital, emergency-department, or general-ward settings. Return an integer score from 0-3; two or more criteria identify adults with suspected infection at greater risk of death or prolonged ICU stay.
Do NOT use when: A poor-outcome prompt, not a sepsis diagnosis and not a sufficiently sensitive standalone sepsis screen. The 2026 Surviving Sepsis Campaign recommends NEWS, NEWS2, MEWS, or SIRS over qSOFA as a single inpatient screening tool. Do not use this adult model in children or as a replacement for SOFA and clinical assessment.

respiratory_rate.description: Respiratory rate in breaths per minute. Scores a point when >= 22.

systolic_bp.description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg. Scores a point when <= 100.

altered_mental_status.description: Altered mentation (GCS < 15). Scores a point when true.

tools.name: calculate_r_factor
tools.description:
Classify a pattern of liver injury from ALT and ALP using the R factor: R = (ALT/ALT_ULN) / (ALP/ALP_ULN). R ≥ 5 is hepatocellular, 2 < R < 5 is mixed, and R ≤ 2 is cholestatic. Returns the R value and injury type. Default upper limits of normal are ALT 40 U/L and ALP 115 U/L; override them with your lab's ULNs if they differ.
Do NOT use when: Normal ULN values vary by lab — pass the correct alt_uln/alp_uln if yours differ. The R factor characterises a pattern; it does not identify the cause.

alt_uln.description: Upper limit of normal for ALT in U/L (default 40).

alp_uln.description: Upper limit of normal for ALP in U/L (default 115).

tools.name: calculate_ranson
tools.description:
Derive the selected Ranson variant from raw timestamped observations; expose the admission subtotal, every criterion state, and missing or not-due reasons without treating absent observations as negative.
Do NOT use when: Do not use an admission subtotal as a completed score, silently select a variant, or infer modern individual mortality, necrosis, disposition, or treatment from this historical model.

etiology_variant.description: Select the non-gallstone or gallstone threshold set explicitly.

assessment_hours.description: Current assessment time. Follow-up criteria remain not due before 48 completed hours.

admission_observed_at_hours.description: Hours relative to admission for the admission observation set; admission observations must be timestamped at hour 0.

followup_observed_at_hours.description: Hours relative to admission for the follow-up observation set; completed criteria use hour 48 observations.

age_years.description: Age in completed years; scores when greater than 55 for non-gallstone or greater than 70 for gallstone pancreatitis.

wbc_admission.description: Raw WBC; scores when greater than 16,000 cells/mm3 (non-gallstone) or 18,000 cells/mm3 (gallstone).

glucose_admission.description: Raw glucose; scores when greater than 200 mg/dL (non-gallstone) or 220 mg/dL (gallstone).

ast_admission.description: Raw AST; scores when greater than 250 U/L in either variant.

ldh_admission.description: Raw LDH; scores when greater than 350 U/L (non-gallstone) or 400 U/L (gallstone).

hematocrit_admission.description: Baseline hematocrit used to derive the 48-hour percentage-point fall.

bun_admission.description: Baseline blood urea nitrogen used to derive the 48-hour rise despite fluids.

hematocrit_followup.description: Raw follow-up hematocrit; scores when the fall from admission is greater than 10 percentage points.

bun_followup.description: Raw follow-up BUN; scores when the rise from admission is greater than 5 mg/dL (non-gallstone) or 2 mg/dL (gallstone).

calcium_followup.description: Raw calcium; scores when below 8 mg/dL.

pao2_followup.description: Non-gallstone only; raw arterial pO2 scores when below 60 mmHg.

base_deficit_followup.description: Raw base deficit magnitude; scores when greater than 4 mEq/L (non-gallstone) or 5 mEq/L (gallstone).

fluid_sequestration_followup.description: Raw estimated fluid sequestration; scores when greater than 6 L (non-gallstone) or 4 L (gallstone).

tools.name: calculate_sodium_deficit
tools.description:
For adults only, calculate Watson total body water and a theoretical sodium-content difference. Keep it separate from treatment choice, infusion volume, and correction-rate limits.
Do NOT use when: Do not use in children or as a sodium dose, saline volume, correction-rate target, or substitute for cause- and symptom-directed hyponatremia management.

desired_sodium.description: Target serum sodium in mEq/L (must exceed current sodium).

age.description: Adult age in years for the Watson TBW equation.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters. Required for the adult (age ≥ 18) TBW formula.

sex.description: Biological sex (male or female). Required for the adult (age ≥ 18) TBW formula.

tools.name: calculate_timi
tools.description:
Risk-stratify a patient with unstable angina or non-ST-elevation MI by awarding one point each for seven clinical criteria (age >= 65, >= 3 CAD risk factors, known CAD with stenosis >= 50%, aspirin use in the past 7 days, severe angina, EKG ST-segment changes >= 0.5mm, positive cardiac marker). Score 0-7 maps to the 14-day risk of all-cause mortality, new or recurrent MI, or severe recurrent ischemia requiring urgent revascularization.
Do NOT use when: Validated for non-ST-elevation acute coronary syndromes (unstable angina / NSTEMI); it is not a diagnostic test and does not apply to ST-elevation MI or to undifferentiated chest pain.

age_65_or_older.description: Age >= 65 years. Scores a point when true.

cad_risk_factors.description: At least three coronary artery disease risk factors (family history, hyperlipidemia, diabetes, hypertension, current smoker). Scores a point when true.

known_cad.description: Known coronary artery disease with stenosis >= 50%. Scores a point when true.

asa_use.description: Use of aspirin in the past 7 days. Scores a point when true.

severe_angina.description: Severe angina, at least two episodes in 24 hours. Scores a point when true.

ekg_st_changes.description: EKG ST-segment deviation >= 0.5mm. Scores a point when true.

positive_cardiac_marker.description: Elevated cardiac biomarker (e.g. troponin, CK-MB). Scores a point when true.

tools.name: calculate_wells_dvt
tools.description:
Estimate the pretest probability of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in a patient with a suspected lower-extremity DVT. Awards +1 for each of nine clinical features (active cancer, paralysis/cast, recent bedridden/surgery, localized tenderness, entire-leg swelling, calf swelling at least 3 cm, pitting edema, collateral superficial veins, previously diagnosed DVT) and SUBTRACTS 2 when an alternative diagnosis is at least as likely as DVT. Score ranges -2 to 9; higher scores mean higher risk.
Do NOT use when: A pretest-probability stratifier, not a diagnosis. Apply the full validated diagnostic algorithm with D-dimer and ultrasonography; do not use for upper- extremity DVT or pulmonary embolism.

active_cancer.description: Active cancer (treatment ongoing, within 6 months, or palliative). Scores +1.

paralysis_or_cast.description: Paralysis, paresis or recent plaster immobilization of the lower extremities. Scores +1.

bedridden.description: Recently bedridden for 3 days or more, or major surgery within 12 weeks. Scores +1.

localized_tenderness.description: Localized tenderness along the distribution of the deep venous system. Scores +1.

calf_swelling.description: Calf swelling at least 3 cm compared to asymptomatic leg (measured 10 cm below tibial tuberosity). Scores +1.

pitting_edema.description: Pitting edema confined to the symptomatic leg. Scores +1.

alternative_diagnosis.description: Alternative diagnosis at least as likely as DVT. SUBTRACTS 2 from the score (the only criterion that is not +1).

tools.name: find_calculator
tools.description: Find calculators by clinical intent, population, model, or known name. Returns at most three relevant matches by default. If status is needs_clarification, do not calculate until the clarification is resolved.

query.description: Clinical intent, named calculator, population, or quantity to compute

limit.description: Maximum matches to return after relevance filtering; defaults to 3

tools.name: describe_calculator
tools.description: Return the declared inputs, outputs, evidence, safety limits, and version metadata for one calculator before running it.

id.description: Calculator id without the calculate_ prefix

tools.name: calculate_panel
tools.description: Run one or more already-selected calculators; in compact mode prefer calculate for a single calculator. Shared inputs bind only to reviewed opt-in shared keys; put role-specific values in overrides. Duplicate ids, unused shared keys, and overrides for unrequested calculators are rejected. Calculator failures remain isolated per result.

calculators.description: Calculator ids to run, e.g. ["gfr","meld"] (omit the calculate_ prefix)

inputs.description: Values keyed by a reviewed sharedKey used by at least one requested calculator

overrides.description: Per-calculator inputs merged over the shared inputs

instructions: OathMCP implements established clinical calculators for decision support, not new research, diagnosis, or treatment. Choose the exact population, clinical model, method, and variant. When the exact calculator is unknown, call find_calculator; ask for clarification if discovery returns needs_clarification and never silently choose. Call describe_calculator before first use or whenever inputs are uncertain, then call the matching calculate_<id> tool. Use calculate_panel only for multiple already-selected calculators. Never invent missing inputs. Respect exclusions, units, warnings, adjustments, and stale-model notices. inputsUsed preserves normalized pre-adjustment values; when adjustments[].applied is true, adjustments[].effective is the value used for computation. Read the linked evidence resource when provenance or interpretation matters, and preserve clinician responsibility for every clinical decision.
